name: MobileNAV Configuration Example
brief: MobileNAV device configuration in AL: one provider, fifteen levels, from three lines to a full flow.
description: An example app for Business Central developers who have not worked with MobileNAV. One provider codeunit declares what the device shows, in fifteen levels: fields on MobileNAV's item page, a button with code behind it, lookups, groups, filters and layout rules, a stock count page of your own with a scan wizard, a dialog that runs your own procedure, profiles, categories, captions and saved filters, a button and a coloured line on MobileNAV's bin page, and a MobileNAV page reached through MobileNAV's own links. Install it, apply it from MobileNAV Configuration, and copy the pattern into a customer app.
